title: Technology Sector Update for 07/31/2018: APPF,MX,CGNX,HLIT - Nasdaq.com
text:

Technology stocks rose Tuesday for the first time in four sessions, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 climbing just under 0.4% this afternoon while the Philadelphia Semiconductor index was more than 0.8% higher today in late trade.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ AppFolio ( APPF ) hit a record high share price on Tuesday, climbing over 17% to an all-time peak of of $72.45 apiece, after the cloud-based business software firm said its Q2 revenue grew to $47.24 million from $35.88 million during the year-ago period and beating the Street view by $1.69 million. The company also raised its FY18 revenue forecast to a new range of $183 million to $185 million, rising more than 27% over prior-year levels and eking past the Capital IQ consensus expecting $182.94 million in revenue this year.
In other sector news:
+ Cognex ( CGNX ) raced over 17% higher on Tuesday, staying within relatively close range of its 23% session high that followed the the machine vision products company surpassing year-ago comparisons with its Q2 net income and revenue and also topping Wall Street expectations. The company earned $0.36 per share on $211.3 million in revenue during the three months ended June 30, up from $0.31 per share on $178.1 million in revenue last year and beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.06 per share and $6.3 million, respectively.
+ MagnaChip Semiconductor Corp ( MX ) Tuesday pushed out to a more than 11% gain after reporting adjusted Q2 net income of $0.23 per share on $199.7 million in revenue, beating analyst estimates by $0.07 per share and $14.7 million, respectively. It also sees revenue for the current quarter ending Sept. 30 in a range of $200 million to $210 million, up from $176.7 million in revenue last year and topping the two-analyst consensus by at least $2.65 million.
- Harmonic ( HLIT ) was nearly 9% lower Tuesday afternoon, paring a small slice of a 10% decline earlier in the session that followed the video-delivery company issuing guidance for Q3 net income and revenue trailing analyst estimates and upstaging better-than-expected Q2 financial results.
